tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: zab pa skor bdun las: phrin las sngon 'gro'i spyi chings bzhugs so:
ྈྈྈྈྈ dus gsum rgyal kun spyi gzugs 'gro ba'i mgon: 'khor 'das kun khyab chos sku kun tu bzang: drug pa'i bdag nyid rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang: sku gsum bdag nyid rnams la phyag bgyi 'o:

o rgyan thor cog rgyal po pad+ma bdag: o rgyan yul du rgyal srid chos kyis skyong: zab pa skor bdun gdams ngag la brten te: o rgyan rgyal khams bde chen sa la bkod: gcig kyang ma lus tshom bur mngon sangs rgyas: rgya gar yul 'ong mu stegs thal bar brlags: chos la bkod nas smaun lam las dbang gis: bod kyi rgyal pos spyan drangs lha srin btul: gtsug lag khang bzhengs rje 'bangs bde la bkod: ma 'ongs don du rin chen gter mang sbas: khyad par zab pa skor bdun yan lag bcas: thugs kyi snying po ma 'ongs don du bzhag: de yang rgyud rnams thams cad lung dang bsdebs: lung rnams man ngag dang bsdebs sgrub thabs bstan: sgrub thabs phrin las dang bsdebs de lag len: ma bur bsdebs te 'di ni lag len gyi: phrin las sngon 'gro'i spyi chings 'dir bstan pa: sngon 'gro'i sbyor ba rang rang gzhung ltar shes: sngon 'gro cho ga'i sa bcad rnam pa bcu: sngon gtor skyabs sems tshogs gsag gzhan du blta: mtshams gcad brda sgo phyag 'tshal bshags pa bya: dam bca' byin dbab mchod byin brlab pa sogs: de dag sngon 'gro'i sa bcad rnam bcu 'o: sa ma ya rgya: mtshams gcod la yang rnam pa gnyis te: dang po bgegs gtor byin gyis brlabs la bgegs bkug: lha gang yin gyi las kyi he ru kar bsgoms nas bka' bsgo ba ni:

hūm̐: rnal 'byor chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: lha dang mkha' 'gro 'byung po'i tshogs: thams cad thugs dam bskangs zin pas: 'du ba'i lha ni ma gtogs pa: dam med bdud rigs 'byung po'i tshogs: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: gal te mi 'gro 'dug srid na: he ru ka dpal thugs khros nas: sprul pa'i khro tshogs mang po yis: rdul du brlag par gdon mi za: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la ha la hūm̐:
zhes drag tu bzlas shing yungs dkar gyis brab: gu gul gyis 'tshubs chil du bdug: mtshams gcad pa dngos ni:

hūm̐: nga ni las kyi he ru ka: khros pa'i stangs stabs phyogs bcur bsgyur: hūm̐ las phyogs bcu'i khro bo yis: phyogs bcu'i gdon tshogs snying la gzir: khro bo'i sprin chen rnam par 'khrigs: phyag mtshan lnga yi gur du phub: mtshon cha khro chung skar ltar 'khrugs: ye shes me lnga phyogs bcur 'bar: ma bcos chos dbyings klong yangs na: bgegs zhes bya ba'i ming yang med: mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub: oṃ karma he ru ka sūr+ya tsan+d+ra dz+wa la raṃ: sarba ma hā kro dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma tsakra tīk+ṣ+ṇa karma kro dha dzñā na dz+wa la pañtsa raṃ raṃ raṃ: rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru hūm̐:
brda sgo dbye ba ni: snod bcud ye shes kyi 'khor lor blta zhing:
hūm̐: chos kun gdod nas dag pa la: snang srid dkyil 'khor ye nas rdzogs: ma rig 'khrul pa'i sgrib g.yogs sgo: rang rig brda yis dbye bar bya: bh+rūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭa:
de nyid rang gi rig pa'i ye shes dang gnyis su med par bltas la phyag 'tshal ba ni:
hūm̐: dbyings rig gnyis su med pa la: snang srid dkyil 'khor chen por rdzogs: khyab gdal chos dbyings chen po la: gnyis su med par brda phyag 'tshal: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho:
de ltar sngon nas ma rtogs pa'i dam tshig nyams chag thams cad bshags pa ni:

hūm̐: snang srid gdod nas dag pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can rnams: thugs rje'i brtse bas bdag la dgongs su gsol: ye nas ma rig 'khrul pas bsgribs pa yi: rnam rtog kun brtags blo yis sgro btags pas: rang rig ye shes don la rmongs pa yis: bsrung mtshams med pa'i dam las 'gal ba dang: bla mar smod cing yi dam spangs pa dang: bsnyen sgrub dzap bzlas tshad du ma 'khyol dang: ting 'dzin lta ba klong du ma gyur cing: gsang bcu gzhan la bsgrags sogs mthol lo bshags: gzhan yang mi spang dang du blang bya dang: spyad par bya dang bsgrub par bya ba dang: shes bya lnga sogs nyi shu rtsa lnga yi: dam las 'gal bar gyur pa mthol lo bshags: nya stong dus bzhi'i mchod pa chag pa dang: sdig can rnams la rtag tu byams byas shing: mkha' 'gro rnams la sha khrag gtor ma chag: sbyor sgrol mchod pa dus las g.yel ba dang: rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang 'gal mthol zhing bshags: gzhan yang sbom po yan lag phra zhib kyi: dam tshig bye ba sa ya grangs med pa: de las 'gal bar gyur pa'i rnal 'byor gyis: 'gyod tshangs gdung ba'i smre ngag 'di 'don pas: rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis: yud tsam gzigs te thugs rjes bzod bzhes gsol: tshangs par bstsal nas mchog dang thun mong gi: dngos grub dka' ba med par 'grub pa dang: rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa mthar bgyis shing:
kun tu bzang po'i rgyal sa zin par shog:
snying po'i dam tshig de nyid las nam yang mi 'da' bar dam bca' ba ni:

hūm̐: rang rig ye shes dkyil 'khor 'di: deng phyin bdag gis mi gtang zhing: 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa: ye nas bde gshegs snying po ste: glo bur sgro btags ma rig 'khrul: bde chen sa la bkod pa'i phyir: snying po'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya: sa ma ya bo dhi tsit+ta hūm̐:1$0000270 rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs dam bskul ba'i gdung shugs drag po'i mthus: chos kyi dbyings las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs te bdag gnas yo byad rnams la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par 1$0000300
bsam: spos bsreg: rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra bsgrag: zhing dang g.yab dar gyis g.yab: dbyangs snyan pos:

hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings kyi pho brang nas: dus gsum bdai gshegs sras dang bcas: thugs rje'i thugs dam gnad nas bskul: byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol: thugs dam chen po'i dus la bab: byin gyis brlab pa'i dus la bab: khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab: dbang mchog bskur ba'i dus la bab: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: byin chen byin phob bcom ldan 'das: mthu chen mthu stsol bcom ldan 'das: dbang chen dbang skur bcom ldan 'das: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: sa ma ya ā be sha ya ā:
mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa la: dang po mchod rdzas kyi dri ma rang kha ba rnams sbyong ba ni:

hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis: chos kun sgyu mar rig pa'i phyir: rig pa'i ye shes raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: raṃ las me byung dngos 'dzin bsregs: yaṃ las rlung byung bag chags gtor: khaṃ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa:
phyi mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni:

trām̐ḥlas bde ba chen po'i zhing khams dbus: bh+rūm̐ las rin po che yi gzhal yas su: rin chen snod du hūm̐ las mchod yon dang: zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos mar me dang: dri chab zhal zas kun bzang mchod sprin 'phro: hrīḥlas rol mo'i gzhal yas khang du gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐: pā d+yaṃ: puṣ+pe: dhū pe: ā lo ke: gan+dhe: nai bid+yā: shab+da āḥhūm̐:
nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni:

ā las thod mchog hūm̐ las khrag chen dang: dbang po'i me tog tshil chen bdug spos dang: zhun chen mar me mkhris chen dri chab dang: sha khrag zhal zas āḥlas rol mo'i sgra: hrīḥlas rig ma bcu drug 'dod yon 'phro: ye shes rol pa'i mchod sprin bsam mi khyab: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā pañtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she oṃ āḥhūm̐:
gsang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni:

yig 'bru gsum las rlung me thod sgyed steng: ā las thabs shes zung 'jug snod yangs par: sha lnga'i mtsho 'khyil bdud rtsi'i ri bo brtsegs: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃḥhrīḥ.āḥmūṃḥlāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ: trām̐ḥyig mtshan pa'i kha chod nyi ma dang: zla ba rdo rje 'bru gsum dbyangs gsal mtshan: me rlung sbyor bas zhu khol rlangs pa yis: 'khor 'das bdud rtsir bkug nas rigs lngar gyur: rjes chags zhu ba'i byang sems bdud rtsir thim: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes sgrub pa'i rdzas: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā:
zhes bzlas:

ā las lcang lor bcas pa'i bhan+dha ru: gdug can bkug nas gtum po drag pos bsgral: rlangs pas nyon mongs rak+ta bkug ste bsgral: rten 'brel bcu gnyis bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang: gīrtī'i gsang ba nas babs rak+ta dang: thams cad 'dres pa'i chags bral rak+ta'i mtsho: oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā:
zhes bzlas:

bh+rūm̐ las gtor snod rin chen gzhal yas khang: sha lnga bdud rtsi snying po rnam pa bcu: bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs rnams 'od zhu nas: bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur pa'i zegs ma las: 'dod yon phung po mkha' la 'phro bar gyur: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta bā la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā:

zhes bzlas shing byin gyis brlab: sngon 'gro'i spyi chings bcu rnams rdzogs so: sa ma ya rgya: de nas dngos gzhi'i phrin las gang yin pa la 'jug ste: de'ang dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin bsgom pa ni:

hūm̐: chos rnams dmigs med spros dang bral: ye nas ma skyes mi 'gags shing: ka nas dag pa'i de bzhin nyid: ma bsgom 'dzin med rang gsal gdab: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ:
kun snang gi ting nge 'dzin ni:
hūm̐: rang byung ye shes snying po can: dmigs gtad mtshan 'dzin bral ba las: 'gro kun thugs rjes 'dren pa'i phyir: chags med snying rjes kun la khyab: hrīḥdharma dhā tu bo dhi tsit+ta ho:
rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni:
hūm̐: 'gro rnams ma lus sangs rgyas sar: bsgral phyir rang byung snying po las: ye shes rgyu yi yi ge shar: thams cad skyed byed chen por bsgom: hūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐:
snod bcud sbyong ba ni:
hūm̐: rang byung snying po'i cho 'phrul las: sku gsung thugs kyi raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: 'phros pas snod bcud stong par sbyangs: slar 'dus rgyu yi yi ger thim:
rgyu'i he ru ka yod pa rnams la:
hūm̐: rang byung snying po he ru ka: yum bcas lhan skyes mkha' la gsal:

de nas phrin las la 'jug par bya'o: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈ gter chen mchog gyur bde chen gling pas karma'i dam can brag nas spyan drangs pa'i gnam lcags phur sgrom chen mo'i rgya mdud nang gi byang bu gru bzhi gu ru'i phyag bris ji lta ba las 'og min karma'i gdan sar phab pa'o/// /
